resources.string: Build a rebuildable local index only for selected documents. Their text, later selected-content updates and search questions are sent to the signed-in embedding service. Turning this off stops sending. Unselected documents and Agent library access remain restricted.
Sign in and confirm that the service provides an embedding model.
Use prefixes required by your deployment. Change the revision or reapply after a model update to rebuild. Server-added instructions are not inferred.
Semantic service or index unavailable. Local keyword search remains available.
